summary: Aircraft type dropdown — populate options from aircraft-types API
description: The Aircraft Type dropdown on the registration form must be populated from the /api/aircraft-types endpoint. Options must load on page mount before the user can interact with the field.

acs.text: Dropdown populates with all active aircraft types from /api/aircraft-types on page load
If the API call fails, the dropdown displays a placeholder option 'Unable to load types — contact support' and is disabled
The dropdown field is disabled and shows a loading indicator until the API response is received

out_of_scope: Adding new aircraft types via this form
